content.comment_body: I'm having trouble downloading the manual for [product_name] [article_no].
It's actually not that difficult. Simply click on this link: [url]. Then choose the correct manual. With just a few more clicks, you should be able to get it.
Thank you, I've managed to download the manual. I think my initial issue was related to my operating system.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced issues downloading the manual for a particular product version, which seemed to be related to their operating system. Although the process is usually simple, OS compatibility might sometimes hinder access to documentation. With support, the user resolved the issue, highlighting the importance of ensuring documentation is easily accessible for all platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to download documentation easily, regardless of their operating system.
